problemStatement: Extend the existing URL shortener with click analytics: record every redirect (timestamp, referrer, user agent) without adding latency to the redirect, and expose an aggregated statistics endpoint per link, while keeping all existing behaviour and tests intact.
functionalRequirements: FR1: Every successful redirect (302) records a click with UTC timestamp, Referer header and User-Agent header (both optional, truncated to safe lengths).
FR2: GET /api/links/{code}/stats returns totalClicks, lastClickedAt, clicksPerDay for the last 7 days (oldest first, zero-filled) and the top 5 referrers (direct visits grouped as '(direct)').
FR3: Stats for an unknown code return 404; stats for a link with no clicks return zeros and empty lists.
FR4: Deleting a link deletes its click history.
FR5: Expired (410) and unknown (404) redirects do not record clicks.
nonFunctionalRequirements: NFR1: Redirect latency must not depend on the analytics write (asynchronous, fire-and-forget into a bounded queue).
NFR2: Analytics loss under overload is acceptable and must be bounded and observable (drop oldest, count drops); redirect correctness is never sacrificed.
NFR3: Buffered clicks are flushed on graceful shutdown.
NFR4: No new external dependencies; SQLite remains the store.
NFR5: All existing tests continue to pass unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: After 3 redirects with Referer https://news.example.org/post/1 and 1 without, stats show totalClicks=4, topReferrers[0]={https://news.example.org/post/1, 3} and a '(direct)' entry with 1, within 10 seconds.
AC2: clicksPerDay has exactly 7 entries, sums to totalClicks for today's clicks, and the last entry is today's date (UTC).
AC3: Stats for a never-clicked link return totalClicks=0, lastClickedAt=null, empty topReferrers.
AC5: 20 consecutive redirects complete well under 5 seconds total and all 20 clicks are eventually recorded.
AC6: The full existing test suite (LinksApiTests, DomainTests) passes without modification.
assumptions: A1: 'Last 7 days' means today plus the six preceding UTC calendar days.
A2: Referrers are compared as full URLs (no host normalisation) in this iteration.
A3: Analytics are per link; there is no global dashboard endpoint yet.

ambiguities.question: Should bot/crawler traffic be excluded from analytics?
ambiguities.defaultAssumption: Record everything; filtering can be applied at query time later.

ambiguities.question: Is eventual consistency (clicks visible within seconds) acceptable for the stats endpoint?
ambiguities.defaultAssumption: Yes - the requirement explicitly prioritises redirect latency.
